name: Otokano ~Otouto no Kanojo ga Bunkei de Tsuyome!?~
original_name: オトカノ ～おとうとの彼女が文系で強め!?～
source:
It’s a summer night. At home.
After six months of dating, I finally cross the line with my humanities-major girlfriend.
After going at it multiple times, we fall asleep, wrapped in each other’s warmth.

The next morning, I wake up to a strange, ticklish sensation between my legs.
Blinking away the sleep, I look down to see someone fondling me with a dazed expression. But it’s not my girlfriend—
It’s my always-stern, overly-serious, science-major… older sister!

[Translated from [url=https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=1373739&adult_view=1]melonbooks[/url]]
translation:
夏夜，家中。
交往半年后，我终于和文科专业的女友跨过了最后一步。
几度缠绵之后，我们依偎着彼此的体温睡去。

第二天早上，一阵奇怪的酥痒感从双腿之间传来，把我唤醒。
我睡眼惺忪地低头一看，有个人正一脸恍惚地抚弄着我。但那不是女友——
而是那个总板着脸、严肃得过了头的理科生…姐姐！

[译自[url=https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=1373739&adult_view=1]Melonbooks[/url]]
